question: How long (in years) will it take for ₹1,680 to become ₹2,100 at a rate of 4% per annum simple interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Interest** earned = ₹2,100 − ₹1,680 = ₹420

**Interest for 1 year** = 4% of ₹1,680 = 16.8 × 4 = ₹67.2

**Number of years (T)** = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year

⇒ T = 420 ÷ 67.2 = 6.25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6.25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Principal (P)** = ₹1,680, **Amount (A)** = ₹2,100, **Rate (R)** = 4% per annum.

**Formula Used:** **Simple Interest (SI)** = (P × R × T) ÷ 100; **Amount (A)** = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08c90d699a5cc89ffcbfbf3907be33dccd40a8252b7c37fefd7dd566228efd5d.png] 

⇒ SI = A − P = 2100 − 1680 = ₹420

⇒ 420 = (1680 × 4 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 420 × 100 = 6720 × T

⇒ 42000 = 6720 × T

⇒ T = 4200 ÷ 672

⇒ T = 6.25 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6.25 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is calculated only on the initial **Principal** amount. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount in Simple Interest

The total money returned after a period is A = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Rate of Interest

If Time and Principal are constant, Simple Interest is directly proportional to the **Rate of Interest**.
